CloudTransferRecord.title: CloudTransferRecord
CloudTransferRecord.description: Represents an encrypted metadata record of a WarpDrop 5 GHz P2P file transfer synced to the user's cloud account.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this transfer record.

fileName.description: Display name of the transferred file (1..255 chars).

sizeBytes.description: Size of the transferred payload in bytes (>= 0).

category.description: Media category of the file (PHOTOS, VIDEOS, MUSIC, FILES, APPS).

direction.description: Whether the file was sent or received by this device.

peerDeviceName.description: Nickname of the peer device involved in the transfer (1..80 chars).

sha256Checksum.description: Verified SHA-256 integrity digest of the transferred payload.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the transfer record was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the transfer record was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/transfer_records/{record.description: Per-user subcollection storing authenticated cloud transfer history records.
